/catalogue/plumbing/pipe-fittings: Geo fittings for joining, turning and capping pipe, in the sizes plumbers ask for most: 15mm and 22mm for household work, up to 110mm for drainage and farm lines. You will find HDPE fittings for poly pipe, compression and capillary fittings for copper, galvanised fittings and stand pipe, soil and vent fittings and underground fittings. Use the list beside the products to narrow down, or search by code. Measure the pipe, or read the size stamped on the old fitting, before you buy. If you are unsure, bring the old part in and we will match it. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/pipe-fittings/hdpe-f: Geo HDPE (poly pipe) fittings for farms, smallholdings and boreholes, in sizes from 20mm to 110mm. Couplers, elbows, tees, end caps, male and female adaptors, clips and ball valves, most of them compression fittings that grip the pipe without glue, so a spanner is usually all you need. Choose by the outside diameter of your pipe, the size marked on the pipe itself. Not sure what you need to connect a pump or a tank? Tell us the pipe size and what it joins to, and we will help you work out the list.
/catalogue/plumbing/pipe-fittings/compre: Geo compression fittings join pipe without solder or glue: couplers, elbows, tees, reducing bushes, stop ends and caps. The 15mm and 22mm sizes suit household copper pipe, and the larger sizes, up to 110mm, are for poly pipe. Copper and poly pipe use different fittings, so check what your pipe is made of before you choose. If you are not sure which type your job needs, bring in a piece of the pipe or the old fitting and we will find the match. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/valves: Geo valves for water supply lines and tanks: lever ball valves from 15mm to 50mm, angle valves for basins and toilets, and float valves. A ball valve opens and closes with a quarter turn, which makes it the usual choice for an isolating valve. Match the size to your pipe, and check the connection at each end, whether compression (for copper), threaded or female-to-female. If you are not certain, photograph the old valve or bring it in, and we will find the right one.
/catalogue/plumbing/valves/ball-valves: Geo lever ball valves from 15mm to 50mm, with compression, male and female ends, full bore and mini versions, and a nylon valve. The 15mm and 22mm sizes are the common household sizes. The letters in the product name describe the ends: C is compression, M is a male thread and F is a female thread, so a CXC valve fits between two compression joints. Check your pipe size and how each end connects before you buy, or bring in the old valve.
/catalogue/plumbing/taps-mixers: Geo taps and mixers, with the spares to keep them running: mixer ranges, the Eternity premium range, taps and tap spares, spouts, shower arms and hoses, and packed taps ready to take home. Replacing a tap? Check how it connects to the basin or sink and how many holes you have, and bring the old tap or a photo if you can, because spare parts are easiest to match against the original. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/bathroom-toilet: Geo bathroom and toilet parts: shower roses in round and square, 100mm to 200mm, in ABS or stainless steel; shower arms; hand showers and hoses; bath and basin wastes and traps; and toilet and cistern parts. A toilet that keeps running is usually down to the inlet valve or the flush valve, so bring the old part and we will match it. For showers, check the thread size on your shower arm before choosing a new rose.
/catalogue/plumbing/geysers: Geo geyser spares: drain cocks, drip trays, gaskets, geyser blankets and the Goflo and Hypaflo ranges. Check the rating plate on your geyser before you buy a valve or an element, because it shows the pressure rating in kPa and the element wattage, and the new part has to match both. A drip tray and a blanket are the simple upgrades that protect the ceiling and cut heat loss. If your geyser is leaking or has stopped heating, tell us what it is doing and we will point you to the right part.
/catalogue/plumbing/tanks-hose: Geo fittings for water tanks and the hoses around them: float valve kits, tank fittings, first flush kits and leaf catchers for rainwater, braided flexible connectors and washing machine inlet and outlet hoses, in sizes from 15mm to 50mm and lengths up to 3m. To fit a tank, we need the pipe size and what type of connection the tank has, so measure the outlet or bring in the old fitting. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/electrical/circuit-protection: Protection and control gear from WACO, much of it from ABB: circuit breakers (MCBs), isolators, contactors and relays, push buttons and other pilot devices, sounders and meters. Trade customers can search by the exact code. When replacing a breaker, match the current rating in amps and the number of poles. If an earth leakage unit keeps tripping, an electrician needs to trace the cause, but we can supply the replacement parts when you know what you need.
/catalogue/electrical/security: Security gear from WACO: a 4-channel, 4-camera CCTV kit, infrared motion sensors, an occupancy sensor and a twin spotlight with a built-in motion sensor. Sensors differ in the angle they cover, 180 or 350 degrees, so choose by the area you need to watch. Looking for an electric fence energizer? There is none in this catalogue yet, so ask us and we will tell you what we can order in.
/catalogue/lighting/floodlights: WACO floodlights for yards, driveways, sites and sports areas: LED floodlights in 300W and 500W, metal halide and HPS floodlights, and an empty floodlight body if you want to fit your own lamp. LED uses less power than metal halide or HPS for similar light, so it is usually the better choice when replacing an old fitting. Check the wattage and the mounting position before you buy, and ask us if you need help choosing.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/inverters: Hybrid inverters from Sunsynk, Deye, Luxpower and Fivestar, from small 5kVA units up to 16kW. To choose one, add up the power of the appliances you want to run at the same time, which sets the inverter size in kW, and check whether your supply is single phase or three phase. The battery voltage also has to match the inverter. Tell us what you want to keep running during an outage and we will help you narrow the list.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/batteries-: Lithium batteries from Sunsynk, Hanchu (the Eenovance range, ex-Sunsynk) and Deye, from about 5kWh up to large high-voltage packs, plus Fivestar deep-cycle gel batteries. To estimate the size you need, multiply the load you want to run in kW by the hours you want backup for. A 500W load for eight hours needs about 4kWh, and you should allow for the fact that not all of a battery's rated capacity is usable. Check that the battery suits your inverter before you buy.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/solar-pane: Fivestar mono solar panels in 295W, 300W, 350W, 380W and 450W. Before deciding how many panels you need, check your inverter's maximum solar input and its voltage range, because the panels you string together have to stay within both. Higher-wattage panels need less roof space for the same output. Tell us which inverter you have or are planning to buy, and we will help you work out the panels.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/kits-backu: Inverter and battery packages from Sunsynk, Deye and Luxpower, mainly 5kW and 6kW inverters with a 5kWh battery, as well as solar PV kits. Packages marked Solar Ready are meant for adding panels later. A package solves the matching problem, since the inverter and battery are chosen to work together. Ask us what each package includes before you order, and tell us what you want to keep running so we can point you to the right size.
/catalogue/power-tools/drills-drivers: Ingco drills and drivers, mostly cordless 20V lithium-ion, with a few corded models: cordless and impact drills, impact drivers, impact wrenches, drive ratchets, small cordless screwdrivers and a kit with an impact wrench. An impact drill is the one for drilling masonry, and an impact driver is for driving long screws quickly. Check whether the tool comes with a battery and charger or as a bare tool before you buy. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/power-tools/grinders: Ingco grinders, both cordless and corded: angle grinders, a bench grinder, a mini grinder and a cordless mini cut-off tool. A 115mm angle grinder is lighter and easier to handle for small cutting and grinding jobs, while a 230mm grinder cuts deeper and suits heavier work. Choose the disc to match the job, since cutting, grinding and polishing each use a different disc. If you are not sure which grinder you need, tell us the job and we will help.
/catalogue/power-tools/welding: Ingco welding gear: inverter welding machines, including an MAG/MMA/TIG/VRD model and a plasma cutter, plus electrode holders and welding rods. An MMA (stick) inverter welder is the simplest machine to learn on, and it works with the welding rods listed here. For farm repairs, work out the thickness of steel you will weld and whether you have a steady power supply, since larger machines need more of it. Ask us if you want help choosing.
/catalogue/power-tools/water-pumps: Ingco water pumps: a jet pump, a water pump, a petrol (gasoline) water pump, cordless 20V transfer and water pumps, and an automatic pump control. To choose the right pump, we need to know where the water comes from, whether a tank, a borehole or a dam, how far it must travel and how high it must be lifted. Tell us the job, and we will help you pick, or order one in.
/catalogue/power-tools/generators-petrol: Petrol (gasoline) machines from Ingco: a generator, a plate compactor, a power trowel, a tamping rammer, a concrete vibrator, an earth auger and multi-tools. Before choosing a generator, add up the power of everything you want to run at once, and remember that motors draw more when they start. Tell us the job or the load and we will help you choose, and anything not on the shelf we can order in.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/compres: Compressors from AirCraft and Ingco, from small airbrush compressors and battery-powered mini compressors to units sold with a spray gun and hose, plus spare parts such as adaptors and capacitors. The tool you want to run sets the compressor you need, because spray guns, nail guns and impact wrenches use different amounts of air. Check the air requirement on your tool before you choose, and ask us if you want help matching the two.
/catalogue/paint-waterproofing/roof-pain: Roof paints and roof coatings from Duram, Africa Paints, Promac and Flash Harry, including Roofkote, Weather Roof, Roof & All, a CoolTech roof paint and a roof-and-pave coating. Roof paint only lasts on a clean, dry, sound surface, so wash off dirt and loose paint first, and check the label for the primer or rust treatment your roof type needs. Tell us what your roof is made of and its condition, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/paint-waterproofing/waterproo: Waterproofing products from Flash Harry, Duram, Promac and Africa Paints: acrylic and bituminous coatings, damp-proofing, cement additives and slurry, and products for roofs, walls and carports. The right product depends on what you are sealing and where, since a flat roof, a damp wall and a water-retaining structure each need something different. Tell us the surface, whether the water is coming from above or below, and the area, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/plumbing/pipe-fittings/capill: Geo capillary (solder) fittings for copper pipe in 15mm and 22mm: elbows in 45 and 90 degrees, couplers, tees, crossovers, running nipples and female iron fittings that change from copper to a threaded connection. Capillary joints are soldered, so they suit permanent copper runs. If you would rather not use a flame, the compression fittings join copper without solder. Measure your pipe, or bring in a piece, and we will match the size.
/catalogue/plumbing/pipe-fittings/galvan: Geo galvanised fittings and stand pipe in sizes from 15mm up to 110mm: barrel nipples, caps, unions, crosses, tees, bends and elbows with female threads at both ends. They are used for threaded steel water lines, stand pipes and irrigation connections. Check the thread size on what you are joining to, and bring in the old fitting if you are unsure. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/pipe-fittings/underg: Geo 110mm underground drainage fittings: gully heads and grids, gully P traps, rodding eyes at 45 degrees, stop ends and female adaptors. They connect to 110mm underground drain pipe. Check that the pipe you are joining to is 110mm, and whether you need a socket or a spigot end. Tell us what you are building or repairing, and we will help you list the parts. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/valves/float-valves: The Geo float valve controls the water level in a tank or cistern: it opens as the level falls and closes as the tank fills. It comes in 15mm, 22mm and 25mm, so check the size of the pipe or the tank connection it fits. A tank that overflows, or a float valve that keeps letting water through, usually needs a new valve or a new washer. Bring the old valve in and we will match it.
/catalogue/plumbing/drainage-rainwater: Geo drainage and rainwater products: floway drainage channels with grates, gullies, corners, end caps and converters, plus PVC and Econo rainwater systems for gutters and downpipes. Measure the length of your roof edge and count the corners and outlets before you buy, so the list adds up. Tell us what you are replacing, and bring a photo of the old gutter profile if you can. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/electrical/wire-wiring-access: WACO wire and cable accessories: compression and cone glands for armoured and unarmoured cable, brass locknuts, adaptors, co-ax cable and 3M cable joint kits, with sizes from 1.5mm up to 150mm. Cable accessories must match the cable they are used with, so check the cable type, armoured or not, and its size before you choose a gland. Trade customers can search by the exact code. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/electrical/switches-plugs-soc: WACO switches, plugs and sockets, from household switches and multiplugs to metal-clad and industrial sockets, caravan and marine plugs, caravan inlets, cordsets and multi-adaptors. Industrial and outdoor sockets have to match the plug and the current rating, so check the amps on the old one before you buy. Wiring work should be done by a qualified electrician, but we can supply the parts and help you find the code.
/catalogue/electrical/circuit-protection: WACO contactors and relays, including the ABB AF contactor range (AF09, AF40 and AF116), contactor relays and RMS-T and RQS-T relays with sockets. These switch motors and heavy loads on and off from a control circuit. When replacing one, match the model code, the coil voltage and whether it is AC or DC. Trade customers can search by the exact code. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/electrical/enclosures-db-boar: WACO enclosures and distribution boards: mild steel and stainless steel enclosures, polycarbonate general-purpose enclosures, the Allbrox and AP ranges, distribution boxes and device plates. Choose by the size of the equipment you need to house, where it will be mounted, and the protection it needs against dust and water. Tell us what goes inside and where it will go, and we will help you find the right box.
/catalogue/electrical/fans-air-movement: Fans and air movers from WACO and Fivestar: 16 inch desk, pedestal and wall fans, 18 inch industrial pedestal and floor-standing fans, larger ceiling-mounted sizes up to 1400mm, and ceiling bathroom heaters. Brits gets hot in summer, so check that the size you want is on the shelf, and ask us to order it in if not. Decide whether the fan should stand, hang or mount on a wall before you choose.
/catalogue/lighting/indoor-led-downlight: WACO indoor downlights and ceiling lights, mostly LED: aluminium, steel and glass fittings, fixed and tilting downlights in chrome, satin chrome, brass and white, plus larger fittings from 180mm to 350mm. Check the cut-out size in your ceiling before you buy, because the fitting has to match it, and choose the finish to suit the room. Bring a photo or the old fitting if you are replacing one.
/catalogue/lighting/outdoor-security-lig: WACO outdoor and security lighting: bulkheads, brick lights, garden spikes, LED outdoor fittings and lantern-style wall lights in half-lantern, up-facing, down-facing and pedestal styles. Check where the light will go and how it mounts, on a wall, a pillar or a spike in the ground, and use a fitting made for outdoor use. For general security lighting, look at our floodlights as well.
/catalogue/lighting/industrial-lighting: WACO industrial lighting for workshops, warehouses and factories: LED highbay fittings, louvre and prismatic diffuser fluorescent fittings in single, twin and triple tube versions, and T8 tube fittings. Match the tube length and wattage if you are replacing a fitting, and remember that LED highbays usually cost less to run than fluorescent fittings of similar brightness. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/lighting/lamps-bulbs: Lamps and bulbs from WACO and Fivestar: energy-saving lamps up to 105W, LED corn lights, LED tubes including 4-foot T8, and portable lanterns and camping torches. Check the cap type, the wattage and whether you want warm or cool white before you buy, or bring the old bulb in and we will match it. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/charge-con: Fivestar solar charge controllers: MPPT controllers in 20A, 30A, 40A and 50A, and PWM controllers from 10A up to 60A at 48V. A charge controller sits between the panels and the battery, so it has to match the battery voltage and handle the current from your panels. An MPPT controller usually gets more from the panels than a PWM one. Tell us your panels and battery and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/protection: Fivestar solar protection gear: DC breakers, DC surge protectors in single, two and three pole versions rated 1000V, an automatic transfer switch rated 63A and an isolator switch fuse rated 400A. Protection devices must be rated for DC and for the voltage and current of your system, so check the specification before you choose. Solar installations should be done by a qualified installer, and we can supply the parts and help you find the right ones.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/installati: Installation parts for solar systems from Fivestar and Sunsynk: battery cables and link cables, terminal lugs, crimping tools, easy wire connectors, a CANBUS cable for Freedom Won and Sunsynk or Solis, and an earth neutral bridge box for Sunsynk inverters up to 16kW. Cable and lug sizes depend on the current in your system, with 16mm and 35mm sizes listed here, so check before you buy. Tell us your inverter and battery and we will help.
/catalogue/power-tools/saws: Ingco saws, both cordless 20V and corded: circular saws, jigsaws, reciprocating saws, band saws and a cut-off saw. The saw should suit the material: a circular saw for straight cuts in boards, a jigsaw for curves and a reciprocating saw for rough cutting and demolition. Check whether a cordless model comes with a battery and charger or as a bare tool. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/power-tools/rotary-hammers: Ingco rotary hammers and breakers, cordless 20V and corded: rotary hammers for drilling in concrete and brick, a demolition breaker and a breaker stand. Use a rotary hammer, not a normal drill, for large holes in concrete, and match the drill bits to the chuck type of the hammer. Tell us the job, and we will help you choose between a rotary hammer and a breaker.
/catalogue/power-tools/drill-bits: Ruwag drill bits for every material: masonry, metal, wood and ceramic bits, drill bit sets and drill chucks. Match the bit to the material, because a bit made for masonry will not drill steel cleanly, and use a ceramic or glass bit for tiles. Sets such as the HSS, masonry and wood combination sets give you a range of sizes for general work. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/power-tools/saw-cutting-blade: Saw and cutting blades from Ruwag and Wadfow: circular saw blades for ripping, crosscutting and aluminium, diamond blades, jigsaw and hacksaw blades, and hole saws, including 115mm sizes. The blade must match the saw's diameter and the size of its centre hole, so read the size on your old blade or the saw before you buy. Use the right blade for the material you are cutting.
/catalogue/power-tools/abrasives-sanding: Abrasives and sanding products, mainly from Ruwag: sanding rolls, sheets, belts, delta sanding discs and metal cutting discs, including 115mm sets. Choose the grit for the job, coarse to remove material and fine to finish, and check the disc size matches your grinder or sander. Tell us what you are sanding or cutting, and we will help you pick. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/spanners-sockets: Spanners and sockets from Wadfow and Ingco: socket sets in 1/4 inch and 1/2 inch drive, ratchets including flex-head and insulated versions, and bit socket sets. The drive size must match the sockets, so check whether your set is 1/4 inch or 1/2 inch drive. Larger bolts usually need a 1/2 inch drive. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/measuring-marking: Measuring and marking tools from Harden, Wadfow and Ingco: spirit levels in aluminium, a cordless 3D laser level, combination squares, chalk line reels, a digital vernier caliper and a digital multimeter, in lengths from 150mm to 1000mm and more. Choose a level long enough for the surface you are checking, since a longer one gives a more accurate result over distance. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/garden-tools: Garden tools from Harden, Wadfow and Ingco: shovels, trowels, lopping and anvil pruners, axes, a folding saw and a bottle sprayer. Check the handle length and the weight, because you will be holding it for hours. Tell us what you are doing in the garden, and we will help you choose. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/tool-storage: Wadfow tool storage: a modular storage tower and plastic organisers in 13.5 inch and 16.5 inch sizes, for sorting screws, nails, bits and small parts in the workshop or the bakkie. Check the inside dimensions against what you plan to keep in them, and decide whether you want to stack units or carry one. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/screws: Ruwag screws for wood, metal and general work: wood screws, chipboard screws, tek screws, top speed screws, cheese head machine screws, with nuts and wing nuts, and brass and plated finishes. Choose the screw by the material you are fixing into, the length and the head type, and use a corrosion-resistant finish outdoors. Bring a sample screw in if you are matching one. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/anchors-wal: Ruwag anchors and wall plugs: drop-in anchors, expansion bolts, eye bolts and hook bolts, hollow wall anchors, coach screws with wall plugs and chipboard screw combo sets. The right anchor depends on the wall: solid brick and concrete take expansion anchors, while hollow walls need hollow wall anchors. Tell us what you are fixing and what the wall is made of, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/ironmongery: Ruwag ironmongery and kits: door and cabinet hardware, pozi bits and magnetic sockets, and installation kits such as the flat screen TV kit, satellite dish kit, extension pole kit, sand filter kit and security safe kit. Check what a kit includes before you buy, and measure doors and cabinets for the size of hinge or handle you need. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/tapes: tesa tapes for masking, packaging, insulation and repair: anti-slip tape, extra Power repair tape, professional aluminium tape, signal tape and masking tape, in widths from 19mm to 50mm. Choose the tape for the surface and the job, since masking tape for painting is not the same as a repair or insulation tape. Tell us what you are taping, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/air-too: AirCraft air tools: nail guns and staplers for 16 gauge and 18 gauge brad nails and 21 gauge staples, with the matching nails, plus sanders, tyre inflators and other air tools. Air tools need a compressor that can supply enough air, so check the tool's air requirement against your compressor. Make sure the nails match your nailer's gauge and length range. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/spray-g: AirCraft spray guns, airbrushes and paint pots, with nozzle sizes from 0.2mm for fine airbrush work up to 1.8mm for heavier paints, and manual and automatic mix paint pots from 10 to 40 litres. A thicker paint needs a larger nozzle, so check the paint maker's guidance. A spray gun also needs enough air from the compressor. Tell us what you are spraying and what compressor you have, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/hoses-h: AirCraft air hoses and hose reels: automatic reels of 9m, 15m, 20m and 30m, including metal and braided versions, in 8mm to 12mm hose sizes, and flexible hose kits with quick couplers. A longer hose loses some pressure, so choose the length you actually need. Check the hose diameter and the coupler type against your compressor and tools. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/hose-fi: AirCraft hose fittings: connectors, brass conical joints, ball valves, four-way connectors and aro-type couplings, for tubes from 4mm to 18mm. Fittings only seal when the type and the size match, so check the tube size and the coupling style on your hose and tools before you buy, or bring a sample in. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/paint-waterproofing/interior-: Interior paints from Promac, Duram and Africa Paints for walls, ceilings, and kitchens and bathrooms, from everyday PVA to decorative and specialist finishes such as chalk walls and brick dressing. Work out the area of the walls before you buy so you get enough in one batch, and prepare the surface properly, because paint only lasts on a clean, sound wall. Tell us the room and the finish you want, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/paint-waterproofing/exterior-: Exterior paints from Promac, Duram and Africa Paints for walls, fascias and gutters, and trim: weather-resistant wall paints, enamels, gloss finishes and a marble texture coating. Exterior paint has to cope with sun and rain, so choose one made for outdoor use and prepare the surface by cleaning and filling cracks. Tell us what you are painting, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/paint-waterproofing/enamel-me: Enamel and metal paints from Promac, Duram and Africa Paints: gloss and eggshell enamels, direct-to-metal (DTM) paints, aluminium silver, braai paint and a truck and tractor paint. Rust must be dealt with before painting metal, and a direct-to-metal paint lets you paint straight onto prepared metal without a separate primer. Tell us what you are painting, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/paint-waterproofing/primers-u: Primers, undercoats and surface preparation from Duram, Promac, Africa Paints and Flash Harry: adhesion and bonding primers, galvanized iron cleaner, brush cleaner and thinners, and an all-purpose crack filler. Good preparation decides how long a paint job lasts, so clean the surface, fill the cracks and use a primer made for the surface you are painting. Tell us the surface and the paint you plan to use, and we will match the primer.
/catalogue/plumbing/pipe-fittings/soil-v: Geo soil and vent fittings for waste and drainage pipe in 40mm, 50mm and 110mm: bends in 22.5, 45 and 90 degrees, male and female adaptors, and an air vent cowel. Check the pipe diameter and whether the joint is a push-fit socket or a threaded adaptor before you buy. Soil pipes also need correct falls and venting, so tell us what you are installing and we will help you list the parts. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/sheeting-membranes: Geo builders sheeting, shadecloth, foil and membrane: black, clear, blue and green sheeting, bulk black rolls, and damp proof course (DPC) in widths from 110mm to 225mm, with edging. Measure the area and the width you need before you buy so you order the right roll. Tell us whether the job is a damp course, a ground cover or a pond or roof liner, and we will help you choose. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/plumbing-consumables: Geo plumbing consumables and tools: flux paste, gas canisters and blow torch heads for soldering, PVC solvent weld, wax rings for toilets, a hacksaw and bubble wrap for insulation. These are the small items you run out of in the middle of a job, so check what you need for the joint you are making. Ask us if you are not sure which solvent or flux goes with your pipe.
/catalogue/electrical/contracting-items-: WACO contracting items and electrical tools, with a few from Wadfow: pliers and wire strippers, allen key sets, HSS drill sets, aluminium step and extension ladders, dust masks and other items electricians and contractors use every day. Check the ladder height, the pliers size and the set contents before you choose. Trade customers can search by the exact code. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/electrical/maintenance-chemic: WACO maintenance chemicals: multi-purpose lubricants, a marine lubricant and water displacer, penetrating oil, battery cleaner with an acid indicator, a battery terminal protector and Brakleen cleaner. Pick the product for the job, since a penetrant that frees a rusted bolt is not the same as a battery terminal protector. Tell us what you are cleaning or protecting, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/electrical/sound-equipment-mi: WACO sirens, bells and warning products: a Banshee mono siren, a school or fire bell, barrier tape, danger tape, detector tape and masking tape, in widths from 18mm to 48mm, plus explosion-proof items. Choose the tape for the use, whether marking a hazard, a buried cable or a surface. Tell us what you need it for, and we will help you pick. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/lighting/fluorescent-fittings: WACO fluorescent fittings for indoor and outdoor use: decorative fluorescents, open channel and empty wide channel fittings for 2 x 18W, 28W, 35W, 36W and 58W tubes. Check the tube type, T8 or T5, the length and the number of tubes before you replace a fitting, or bring the old one in. LED tubes can replace fluorescent tubes in many fittings, so ask us if you want to save on running costs.
/catalogue/lighting/lamp-holders-spotlig: WACO GU10 lamp holders and Saturn spotlights in white. A GU10 lamp holder takes GU10 bulbs, so check the bulb type before you buy a replacement. Bring the old holder or spot in, or a photo, and we will match it. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/monitoring: Sunsynk monitoring parts: a current transformer (CT coil) that works with Sunsynk and Deye inverters, a battery BMS converter called the Klik, and a WiFi and RJ45 data logger for watching your system remotely. Check that the part matches your inverter and battery model before you order. Tell us what inverter and battery you have, and we will help you find the right one.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/solar-ligh: Fivestar solar lights and 12V DC appliances: a solar house number light, a solar stand fan, a steam iron, an angle grinder, hair clippers and a hot melt glue gun, all running on 12V DC. These work off a 12V battery or supply, so check the voltage and wattage against what you plan to power them from. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/ev-charger: The Hanchu AC electric vehicle charger, in 7kW, 11kW and 22kW versions. The charger you can use depends on your electrical supply and the car's on-board charger, so check both before you choose. Installation must be done by a qualified electrician. Tell us your car and your supply, and we will help you work out the right model or order it in.
/catalogue/power-tools/sanders-polishers: Ingco sanders and polishers, cordless 20V and corded: palm, belt and finishing sanders, an angle polisher and a cordless polisher. The sander should suit the job: a belt sander removes material quickly, a palm or finishing sander gives a smoother finish. Check whether a cordless tool comes with a battery and charger or as a bare tool. Our abrasives are in a separate category. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/power-tools/planers-routers: Ingco planers and routers: an electric planer, a cordless 20V planer, a thickness planer and an electric router. A planer smooths and trims the edges and faces of timber, and a router cuts grooves and shapes edges. Check the cutting width and depth against the work you do. Tell us the job and we will help you choose, and anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/power-tools/batteries-charger: Ingco batteries and chargers for cordless tools: 16V and 20V lithium-ion battery packs, single and 2-port chargers and a USB cable. The battery and charger must match the voltage of your tools, so check the voltage printed on your tool or battery before you buy. If you are not sure, bring the old battery in and we will match it. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/power-tools/power-bits: Power bits and bit sets from Ruwag, Ingco and Wadfow: screwdriver bit sets in cases, pop-up sets, dial-a-bit sets, hex bits and magnetic extension bit holders. Match the bit to the screw head, whether Phillips, Pozidriv, slotted or hex, and the size, because a bit that does not fit properly damages the screw. Bring a screw in if you are unsure. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/screwdrivers-sets: Screwdrivers and sets from Harden, Ingco and Wadfow: multi-bit and ratchet screwdriver sets, precision sets, T-handle wrench sets, hex key wrenches and adjustable wrenches, in lengths from 150mm to 450mm. Choose the tip to fit the screw head and the length for the space you are working in. Precision sets suit electronics and small repairs. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/pliers-gripping: Pliers and gripping tools from Harden, Ingco and Wadfow, from 100mm up to 600mm: pump pliers, pipe wrenches, clamps and vices, and many more. Choose the type for the job, since pliers for gripping and pipe wrenches for plumbing do different work. Check the jaw opening for the size of the pipe or the nut. Use the filters beside the products to narrow by brand or size.
/catalogue/hand-tools/hammers-striking: Hammers and striking tools from Harden, Ingco and Wadfow: claw hammers in 16 oz and 20 oz with fibreglass, oak wood or one-piece forged handles, ball pein hammers and axes. A claw hammer is the all-round choice for nails and pulling them out, while a ball pein hammer suits metalwork. Check the weight and the handle material, which affects comfort and shock. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/chisels-punches: Chisels, punches and crowbars from Harden, Ingco and Wadfow: cold chisels in 250mm and 305mm, concrete chisels, cold chisel and punch sets, a crow bar and steel brushes. Match the chisel to the material, because a cold chisel for metal and a concrete chisel for masonry have different edges. Wear eye protection when striking. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/saws-cutting: Saws and cutting tools from Harden, Ingco and Wadfow: hand saws, folding saws, bolt cutters, cable cutters and knives, an auto pipe cutter and more, in lengths up to 900mm. Choose the tool for the material: a bolt cutter for bolts and chain, a cable cutter for cable, a pipe cutter for pipe. Check the cutting capacity before you buy. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/clamps-vices: Clamps and vices from Wadfow, Ingco and Harden: F clamps, belt clamps, corner clamps in 70mm and 75mm, bench vices and more, with lengths up to 350mm. Choose the clamp by how far it must open and how much pressure the job needs, and a bench vice by its jaw width. Tell us what you are holding, and we will help you choose. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/finishing-plasteri: Finishing and plastering tools from Harden, Ingco and Wadfow: drywall taping knives and skimming blades, bricklaying and gauging trowels, wire brushes, a hex paint mixer and a grout remover hand saw, in blade widths from 25mm to 225mm. Choose the trowel or knife size to suit the area you are covering, and keep the tool clean so it works smoothly. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/hand-tools/safety-gear: Safety gear from Wadfow and Harden: kneepads and a welding helmet. Use kneepads when working on hard floors for long periods, and always wear a proper welding helmet when welding. Check the size and the fit before you buy. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/nails: Nails from Ruwag, Ingco and Harden: clout nails, brad nails, concrete nails, corrugated nails, blue tack nails and a drywall indenter. Choose the nail by the material and the length, since the nail must pass through the board and go well into the timber behind it. Use a concrete nail for brick and concrete, and a galvanised finish outdoors. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/nuts-bolts-: Ruwag nuts, bolts and washers: hex, dome and coupling nuts, square bolts with nuts, bonded washers, brass and zinc plated flat washers and fender washers. Match the bolt, the nut and the washer in size and thread, and choose brass or a plated finish where it will get wet. Bring a sample in if you are matching one, and we will find the right size. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/rivets: Ruwag blind rivets, including countersunk and large flange types. Blind rivets join sheet metal and other thin materials from one side, using a rivet gun. Choose the rivet length to suit the total thickness of the material, and the head to suit the finish you want. Tell us what you are joining and we will help you choose. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/threaded-ro: Ruwag stainless steel threaded rod, for hanging, bracing and heavy fixings. Stainless steel resists rust, so it suits damp and outdoor use. Check the diameter and the length you need, and the matching nuts and washers. Tell us what you are building, and we will help you match the parts. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/fastener-ki: Fastener kits and pre-packs from Ruwag and Wadfow: hex nut, hook and screw assortments with up to 225 pieces, brace mend plates, chipboard screws and installation kits such as the flat screen TV kit and extension pole kit. An assortment is handy for the workshop, because you have the common sizes to hand. Check what a kit includes before you buy. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/mounting-ha: tesa adhesive mounting products for hanging things without drilling: adhesive nails for wallpaper, canvas and plaster, tiles and metal, and adjustable versions. Check the weight each product holds, shown on the pack, and the surface it suits, since wallpaper, plaster, tile and metal each need the right type. Clean the surface first. Tell us what you want to hang and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/fixings-adhesives/weather-sea: tesamoll weather sealing for doors and windows: door brushes, door-to-floor double rolls, and P, E and I profile seals. Measure the gap along your door or window and its width before you buy, since the profile has to fit the gap. A well-sealed door keeps out dust, draughts and insects. Tell us the size of the gap, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/air-tre: AirCraft air treatment parts: filters, regulators and lubricators, in-line filters, water traps and auto drain valves. These clean and condition compressed air before it reaches your tools, and a regulator sets the pressure. Check the thread size and the flow rating against your compressor and tools. Tell us what you are running, and we will help you choose. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/tubing: AirCraft air tubing by the metre: nylon tube and polyurethane hose in outside diameters from 4mm to 14mm, in black, blue, green and transparent. Match the tube to your push-in fittings by the outside diameter. Polyurethane hose is more flexible than nylon. Measure the run you need and ask us to cut it to length. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/push-in: AirCraft push-in (PU) fittings for 4mm to 14mm tube: elbows, straight connectors, closing plugs, flow control fittings and manifolds. Tube pushes in and locks without tools. The tube outside diameter must match the fitting, so check the size printed on your tube, and check the thread on the other end. Bring a sample fitting in, and we will match it. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/gauges: AirCraft pressure gauges in 40mm, 50mm and 63mm, with bottom or rear connection, and a glycerine-filled version in a metal case. Check the connection position and thread, the dial size and the pressure range against your compressor or system. The glycerine filling steadies the needle when there is vibration. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/air-tools-compressors/vacuum-: AirCraft vacuum pumps: an oil-free piston type, a mini piston type and an inflation compressor with vacuum pump. Check the vacuum level you need and whether you want an oil-free pump. Tell us what you will use it for, and we will help you choose or order one in.
/catalogue/paint-waterproofing/wood-care: Wood care products from Promac, Duram and Africa Paints: interior, marine and polyurethane varnishes in gloss and suede, stain and seal, deck dressing and furniture wax. Choose a product made for interior or exterior use, and sand and clean the wood first for a good finish. Tell us what you are finishing and whether it will be in the sun or the rain, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/paint-waterproofing/cleaners-: Cleaners, strippers and thinners from Promac, Duram and Flash Harry: cement cleaner, a clean and degrease product, paint strippers, E-type thinners, a brush cleaner and a galvanised iron cleaner. Use the right cleaner for the surface, and follow the label for safety and rinsing. Tell us what you are cleaning or stripping, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/paint-waterproofing/floor-aut: Floor, automotive and industrial paints from Duram, Promac and Africa Paints: stoep and showfloor polyurethane floor paints, road marking and mine marking paint, a stone chip coating and Durabak. Floor paints need a clean, dry, sound surface and the right preparation. Tell us what the floor is made of, where it is, and how much traffic it carries, and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/plumbing/pipe-fittings/pipe: Geo pipe by the length: copper pipe, PEX pipe with inserts, HDPE pipe, perforated Drainex drainage pipe and PVC downpipe, in sizes from 15mm and 22mm up to 110mm. Choose the pipe for the job, whether water supply, drainage or a farm line, and check the diameter and the length you need. Tell us what you are plumbing and we will help you match the pipe to the fittings. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/pipe-fittings/batts-: Geo batts and couplings: aluminium holderbatts, plastic tuffbatts in terracotta and white, fixation bolts and SSN couplings, in sizes from 15mm to 110mm. A holderbatt clips a pipe to a wall or beam, so choose the size to match the pipe diameter and the surface you are fixing to. Bring the old clip in if you are matching one. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/valves/gate-valves: Geo gate valves in 15mm to 40mm: compression-ended (CXC) and female-by-female (FXF) versions, including a full bore gate valve. A gate valve opens fully to let water flow with little restriction, and it suits isolating a supply that is usually left open. Check your pipe size and how each end connects before you buy. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/valves/angle-valves: Geo angle valves in 15mm, including a dual angle valve and an elbow version. They connect the water supply to a basin tap or a toilet cistern and let you shut off that one fitting without closing the whole house. Check the connection type on your pipe and on the tap or cistern. Bring the old valve in if you are replacing it.
/catalogue/plumbing/valves/check-valves: Geo check valves in sizes from 15mm to 40mm: non-return valves with compression ends, spring-loaded check valves and swing check valves. A check valve lets water flow one way only, which protects pumps and stops backflow. The direction matters, so fit it the way the arrow on the body points. Check your pipe size before you buy, and tell us the job if you need help choosing.
/catalogue/plumbing/valves/stopcocks: Geo stopcocks in 15mm and 22mm, with compression ends or female threads. A stopcock isolates the water supply to a house or a section of pipe. Match the size to your pipe and check the end connections before you buy. Bring the old stopcock in if you are replacing it, and we will find the match. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/valves/washing-machi: Geo washing machine valves in 15mm: straight, elbow and tee versions. They give a washing machine its own tap on the supply pipe, so you can shut the water off to the machine without closing the whole house. Check the pipe size and whether a straight, elbow or tee suits the space. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/valves/other-valves: Geo valves that do not fit the other groups: compression and threaded ball valves, a nylon T-handle valve and a Y strainer valve, in sizes from 15mm to 40mm. A Y strainer catches debris in the line before it reaches a pump or a meter. Check the size and the connection type before you buy, or tell us the job and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/plumbing/taps-mixers/mixer-ra: Geo mixer tap ranges, including Arctic, Cosmos, Jabulani, Lindi, Nova and Shadow. Each range has its own look and finish, so choose the style to suit your basin, bath or sink. Check whether the mixer is for a basin, a bath or a kitchen sink, and the number of holes it needs, before you buy. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/taps-mixers/eternity: The Geo Eternity premium range: bath and basin spouts, round and rectangular hand showers, shower arms, bottle traps and pop-up bath wastes. These pieces are made to match, so choose them together for a consistent finish. Check the sizes against your existing plumbing, and bring photos if you are updating an existing bathroom. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/taps-mixers/taps-tap: Geo taps and tap spares in 15mm and 22mm: garden taps, NFR taps, mixer spouts, brass back nuts, extension pieces and headparts. If a tap drips, the headpart or the washer is usually the part to replace, so bring the old part in and we will match it. Check the thread size and whether the tap is a bib tap or a pillar tap.
/catalogue/plumbing/taps-mixers/packed-t: Geo packed taps and tap spares in boxes or packs: aerators, bulb taps and headparts, jumpers and washers, O-rings, clips and brass extension pieces. These are the small parts that fix a leaking or loose tap. Bring the old part in, because the easiest way to match one is to compare it side by side. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/bathroom-toilet/show: Geo shower and bath parts: BDP and NFR shower roses in ABS and stainless steel, from 100mm to 200mm, shower arms, hand showers and combinations. Check the thread size on your shower arm before you choose a new rose, and decide between round and square to suit the room. Tell us what you are replacing and we will help you match it.
/catalogue/plumbing/bathroom-toilet/toil: Geo toilet and cistern parts: close-couple dual and front flush kits, cistern stoppers, and the parts that go with them, with sizes up to 220mm. A toilet that keeps running is usually down to the inlet valve or the flush valve seal. Bring the old part in, or tell us the make of your cistern, and we will match it. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/bathroom-toilet/wast: Geo wastes and waste spares: basin and bath plugs, BDP black and stainless steel wastes, NFR wastes, kitchen sink wastes and brass back nuts, in sizes from 32mm to 90mm. Check the waste size against the hole in your basin, bath or sink, and the finish you want. Bring the old waste in if you are matching one. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/bathroom-toilet/trap: Geo traps for basins, baths and sinks: adjustable plastic traps and combination traps, BDP brass bottle traps, flexi bath and combination traps, and spare clamps, in 32mm, 40mm and 50mm. Choose the trap size to match your waste outlet and the pipe it connects to. Flexi traps help when the waste pipe does not line up exactly. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/drainage-rainwater/d: The Geo Floway drainage system: channel with grates in 1m lengths, gullies, corners, end caps and converters. It collects surface water from driveways, patios and yards. Measure the length of the run and count the corners and outlets before you buy. Tell us the job, and we will help you list the parts. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/drainage-rainwater/p: Geo PVC rainwater fittings: fascia and barge fittings, gutter bolts and nuts, polytop nails, first flush kits and leaf catchers. Count the corners, joins and outlets along your roof edge before you buy. First flush kits and leaf catchers help keep a rainwater tank clean. Bring a photo of your gutter profile if you are replacing parts. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/drainage-rainwater/e: Geo Econo rainwater: D-shaped and half-round gutters, with matching gutter fittings and downpipe fittings. Choose the profile to match your existing gutter, or a full new set. Measure the length of the roof edge and count the corners and outlets before you buy. Tell us what you are fitting and we will help you work out the parts. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/tanks-hose/tank-fitt: Geo tank fittings and accessories in sizes from 20mm to 50mm: brass float valve kits, cam fittings, hose connectors, leaf catchers and first flush kits. To fit a tank, we need the pipe size and the connection type on the tank, so measure the outlet or bring in the old fitting. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/tanks-hose/hose: Geo hoses and connectors: braided and flexi connectors in 15mm, and washing machine connectors and inlet and outlet hoses, in lengths of 2m and 3m. Measure how far the connection must reach and check the end fittings before you buy. Certified braided connectors are a good choice for connecting taps and geysers. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/plumbing/sheeting-membranes/b: Geo builders sheeting and damp proof course: black, clear, blue and green sheeting, bulk black rolls, DPC and co-extruded DPC in widths of 110mm, 150mm and 225mm, and edging. Choose the width to match the wall thickness for a damp course, and measure the area for sheeting. Tell us the job and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/plumbing/sheeting-membranes/s: Geo shadecloth, foil and membranes: shadecloth with clips, reflective foil, birdproof netting, Fibertex geotextile and a stitchbond waterproofing membrane. Measure the area before you buy, and choose the product for its job, whether shade, insulation, bird control, drainage or waterproofing. Tell us what you are covering and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/electrical/switches-plugs-soc: WACO switches, mostly industrial and trade: enclosed and base mount isolators, change-over switches with centre off, front-operated switch-disconnectors and auxiliary contact blocks, many from ABB. Match the current rating in amps and the number of poles, and check the enclosure rating if it will be outdoors. Trade customers can search by the exact code. Anything not on the shelf we order in.

WACO plugs, multiplugs and extension cords: multi-adaptors, double adaptors, Euro adaptors, dedicated plug tops, cordsets and extension cords, in cable sizes from 1mm to 2.5mm. Check the amp rating of the plug and the cable size against the load, and do not overload an adaptor. Anything not on the shelf we order in.

WACO industrial plugs and sockets: metal-clad Busch-DIN sockets, a 63A metal-clad socket outlet, caravan and marine plugs and sockets and caravan inlets. Industrial and marine plugs must match the socket and the current rating. Check the amps and the pin layout on the old one. Installation should be done by a qualified electrician. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/electrical/circuit-protection: WACO circuit breakers (MCBs) and related protection, much of it ABB: double pole breakers, single and double pole isolators, class II surge protection with 40kA ratings, and busbars. Match the current rating in amps, the number of poles and the breaking capacity of the breaker you are replacing. Wiring work should be done by a qualified electrician. Trade customers can search by exact code.

WACO isolators and outlets: aluminium fireman switches, enclosed isolators, surface-mount switch sockets and weatherproof switched and unswitched sockets. Check the current rating, and the weatherproofing needed if it will be outside. Installation should be done by a qualified electrician. Trade customers can search by the exact code. Anything not on the shelf we order in.

WACO automation and pilot devices, many from ABB: manual motor starters (MS116 and MS132), emergency stop push buttons, compact and modular pilot devices and auxiliary contacts. Match the model code, the rating and the type of contact you need. Trade customers can search by the exact code, and we can order in codes that are not on the shelf.

WACO sounders: the Flashtone and the Multitone. Sounders give an audible warning for alarms and process signals. Check the supply voltage and the tone you need. Tell us what the sounder is for, and we will help you choose. Anything not on the shelf we order in.

WACO meters: a single-phase meter and a kWh meter. A kWh meter measures how much electricity a circuit or a unit uses. Check whether your supply is single phase or three phase, and how the meter mounts. Meters should be installed by a qualified electrician. Tell us what you want to measure and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/electrical/batteries-torches: WACO batteries and torches, including Energizer coin and button cells, and other batteries and torches. Check the battery type printed on the old one, or bring it in so we can match it. Button cells such as the 2025 and 2032 come in different sizes, so the number matters. Please note these are everyday batteries and torches, not fence energizers.
/catalogue/lighting/indoor-led-downlight: WACO aluminium downlights: bevelled rim fixed and tilting fittings in chrome, satin chrome, brass and white. Choose the finish to suit the room, and check the cut-out size in your ceiling before you buy. Tilting versions let you aim the light. Bring a photo or the old fitting if you are replacing one. Anything not on the shelf we order in.

WACO steel downlights: eyeball and stilt fittings in chrome, satin chrome and white, plus electronic transformers. Check the cut-out size and the bulb type, and whether the fitting needs a transformer. An eyeball fitting can be aimed, which suits feature lighting. Bring the old fitting in if you are matching one. Anything not on the shelf we order in.

WACO LED indoor lights: built-in spotlights on plates, bars and curved bars, pendant lights and more. Choose the number of lights and the style to suit the room, and check the mounting type, whether built in, on a plate or hanging. Tell us the room and the look you want, and we will help you choose. Anything not on the shelf we order in.

WACO glass ceiling and wall lights: round white fittings in 180mm, 230mm, 260mm and 290mm, and alabaster ceiling and wall lights. Choose the diameter to suit the room and check the bulb type it takes. Measure the space and bring a photo of the room if you want help choosing. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/lighting/outdoor-security-lig: WACO bulkhead lights: oval plain, eyelid and grid bulkheads in the B48 and B50 ranges. Bulkheads are tough wall or ceiling lights for passages, entrances and outdoor areas. Choose the style, plain, eyelid or grid, and check the bulb type and the weather protection you need. Bring the old fitting in if you are matching one.

WACO brick lights and lanterns for walls and pillars: half lanterns of 3, 4 and 5 panels, up-facing and down-facing lanterns, and pedestal lights. Choose the style for where it will go, whether on a wall or a pillar, and check the bulb type. Anything not on the shelf we order in.

WACO LED outdoor lights: sensor floodlights in 10W, 20W, 30W and 50W, a twin 10W sensor spotlight and a tripod with two floodlights. A sensor switches the light on when it detects movement, which suits security. Choose the wattage for the area to light, and check the weather rating. Anything not on the shelf we order in.

WACO garden spikes, for mounting a garden light on a spike pushed into the ground. Check which garden lights the spike suits and the height you need, and make sure outdoor wiring is done safely by a qualified electrician. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/lighting/fluorescent-fittings: WACO indoor fluorescent fittings: decorative fluorescents for 2 x 18W, 28W, 35W, 36W and 58W tubes, and open channel types. Check the tube type, T8 or another, the length and the number of tubes, or bring the old fitting in. LED tubes can replace fluorescent tubes in many fittings, so ask us if you want to reduce running costs.

WACO outdoor and vapour-proof fluorescent fittings: Pecron and empty vapour-proof fittings for 1 x 18W up to 2 x 58W tubes. A vapour-proof fitting is sealed against dust and moisture, so it suits damp, dusty and outdoor places such as car ports and workshops. Check the tube length and number before you buy. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/lighting/general-lighting: WACO general lighting: LED flat lights, batten and bracket fittings, braai lights, bowl fittings, bell press switches and brass backplates, plus a Fivestar item. Check the type of fitting, the bulb or tube it takes and where it will mount. Bring the old fitting or a photo if you are replacing one, and we will help you match it. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/solar-backup-power/batteries-: Hanchu residential single-phase energy storage: HESS hybrid and off-grid inverters from 3kW to 10kW, a gateway, a Pola 16L unit and Home ESS low-voltage batteries. A single-phase system suits most homes with a single-phase supply. Check your supply, your daily usage and what you want to run during an outage. Tell us what you need, and we will help you choose.

Hanchu residential three-phase energy storage: HESS hybrid inverters in three-phase models from 5kW up to 20kW, and Home ESS high-voltage batteries of 2.7kWh and 5.12kWh. Choose a three-phase system if your home or farm has a three-phase supply. Tell us your supply and what you want to keep running, and we will help you choose.

Hanchu commercial and industrial energy storage: CESS cabinets and hybrid inverters, including 105kWh, 215kWh and 418kWh systems and 25kW to 50kW hybrid inverters. These systems suit businesses, farms and sites with larger loads. They need proper planning and installation, so tell us what you need to power and we will help you work out the right system.
/catalogue/power-tools/garden-cleaning: Ingco garden and cleaning tools, mostly cordless 20V with some petrol models: backpack sprayers, blowers, chain saws, grass trimmers, hedge trimmers and pole hedge trimmers. A cordless tool is quiet and easy to start, while a petrol tool suits longer or heavier work. Check whether a cordless model comes with a battery and charger or as a bare tool.
/catalogue/power-tools/other-power-tools: Other Ingco power tools, mostly cordless 20V: caulking guns, concrete vibrators, tile vibration machines and cordless nailers for brad, brick and pin nails. These are specialist tools for particular jobs, so check the job against the tool. Check whether a cordless tool comes with a battery and charger or as a bare tool. Tell us the job and we will help you choose.
/catalogue/power-tools/drill-bits/masonr: Ruwag masonry drill bits: industrial concrete bits in standard and long lengths, multi-purpose bits, SDS and hex core bits and core drill pilot bits. Use a masonry bit for brick, block and concrete, and an SDS bit only in an SDS drill. Match the bit size to the plug or anchor you will use. Anything not on the shelf we order in.
/catalogue/power-tools/drill-bits/metal-: Ruwag metal drill bits: HSS, cobalt, double-ended stub, step drills, countersink drills and annular cutters. Cobalt bits last longer in hard metals such as stainless steel, while a step drill makes clean holes in sheet metal. Use cutting oil and a slower speed for harder metal.
